task: Replace benchmark-visible playground and street-furniture primitive renderers with manufacture-aware assemblies, correct slide/diffuser physical profiles, enforce four-level LOD binding and persist machine-readable construction/material evidence without inventing render quality.

commits.message: Add manufactured park and street furniture detail pass
Add park and street furniture construction contract
Gate benchmark saves on park furniture construction QA
Fix furniture contract QA token validation
Refine slide sheet and lamp diffuser physical profiles
Require physical furniture refinement before benchmark save
Correct furniture dimensions and reference physical construction
Rebind refined furniture meshes into four-level LOD groups
Bind refined furniture renderers into benchmark save gate

slide.centerline: continuous cubic Hermite vertical profile; approximately 26.6 degree start slope flattening to approximately 1.7 degree runout
slide.correctionDuringRun: The first-pass 35 mm visual chute thickness was rejected during static review as physically dishonest. It is now disabled before benchmark save and replaced by the reference-bounded continuous 2 mm shell.

bench.causeBasedGroundContact: lower support zones use darker/rougher non-metallic contact concrete for capillary moisture and splash rather than painted AO

lamp.pole: segmented/tapered concrete with separate metal neck/cap
lamp.diffuser: five-point lathed retained-ring globe profile, replacing the first-pass primitive-like diffuser

lod.refinedRendererRebinding: Explicit LOD Renderer arrays are rebuilt after physical refinement so PhysicalChute and PhysicalDiffuser do not remain unmanaged all-distance renderers; oversized first-pass chute/diffuser renderers are excluded.

materials.microtextureStatus: scalar PBR is implemented; dedicated stainless abrasion, timber grain and paint/concrete micro-normal/roughness textures are specified in the contract but must not receive visual credit until produced/tuned against real grazing-light captures

referenceBasis: Yokohama City park guideline: slide surface SUS304 >=1.5 mm; stainless side >=1.5 mm or painted steel >=2.3 mm
Tsukumura Seisakusho stainless slide example: approximately four-metre slide length and stainless sliding surface

implementation.persistence: Benchmark scene save gate runs after GroundHighDetail exists: validate metadata -> rebuild manufactured furniture -> apply physical profiles -> rebind explicit LOD renderer arrays -> run construction/material/profile/LOD QA.

verification.branchDiffAtSubstantiveHead: 9 commits ahead, 0 behind startHead; five changed files, all under UnityProject; no Godot path touched
criticalStaticCorrectionsMade: rejected 35 mm readability-thickness chute and replaced it with 2 mm reference-bounded SUS shell
replaced primitive-like lamp diffuser with lathed profile
caught refined-mesh LOD binding hazard and explicitly rebuilt LOD Renderer arrays

implementationReadiness.reasonNotIncreased: The existing readiness policy reserves the remaining seven points for actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification. More source code, geometry or metadata cannot substitute for editor execution.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.evidenceNeeded: benchmark crop must show real slat gaps, two-support bench construction, two-post notice board, separate rail/deck/fastener interfaces and the continuous thin slide skin without placeholder silhouettes
grazing capture must show stainless reflections coming from the actual sky/probes while paint, timber, concrete and diffuser remain dielectric; no baked highlight or impossible metallic response
bench/lamp/post ground-contact darkening must stay localized to plausible splash/capillary zones; stainless abrasion and paint aging must follow use/exposure rather than uniform grime
furniture must read as ordinary late-20th-century Japanese residential-estate park equipment, with globe-era lamp and non-digital notice board rather than modern LED/electronic forms
camera movement through all four LOD transitions must show no all-distance refined renderer, silhouette double-render, visible pop or thin-sheet shimmer

criticalDefectRiskAddressed: visible Unity primitive placeholder geometry in park/street-furniture framing
oversized physically false slide sheet thickness
visible LOD pop from stale renderer arrays
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner. On first available native render, stop speculative expansion and capture a park/street-furniture-visible 3840x2160 view plus 100 percent crops. Inspect the 2 mm chute edge and runout under grazing light, deck/frame interfaces, bench slat/bolt/contact construction, lamp diffuser silhouette/material response, notice-board post/frame grounding and all four LOD transitions. Fix observed defects before adding more detail.
note: Visual Fidelity points awarded this run: 0. The repository gate remains 92/100 with category hard minimums and critical automatic fails, but this run is implementation/readiness evidence only and must never be interpreted as a Visual Fidelity PASS.
